handoff: review#1: approve. Every ask in the story is met: triage offers quick|story|close; new read-only reproduce workflow (norn-diagnose → confirm gate, ## Reproduce comment); quick implement starts with a red test built from the reproduce loop; fix/spec deleted; bug template applies norn:wf:reproduce; docs and skills updated; tests added. Full suite 1239 pass, typecheck green. Minor: person must create the norn:wf:reproduce label on GitHub (F1); the triage skill's bug-without-label rule pairs Recommend quick with a reproduce Run line (F2); nit: CONTRIBUTING step 5 still says every workflow ends at a ready gate (F3).

findings.title: norn:wf:reproduce label not created yet
findings.detail:
The spec says 'create the `norn:wf:reproduce` label'. That is a remote write the agent may not make (handoff notes it). Until the label exists, a GitHub issue template drops the unknown label, so bugs fall back to triage.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Person: `gh label create norn:wf:reproduce` before or right after merging.

findings.title: Bug-without-label rule pairs Recommend: quick with a reproduce Run line
findings.detail:
'An issue that turns out to be a bug … is a `quick` … with the `Run:` line `norn workflow gh-<N> reproduce --to reproduce`'. The template above says Run is `norn workflow gh-<N> <workflow> --to <start step>` for the recommended workflow, and the table gives quick → implement. So the comment says quick and the command says reproduce, which can confuse the person at the gate.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Say plainly that the outcome is `quick` (the closest one available) and that the Recommend reason must say 'bug: reproduce first', or point to the gate prompt's bug line.

findings.title: Step 5 still says every workflow ends at a ready gate with a PR
findings.detail:
Untouched line '5. **A person merges.** Every workflow ends at a `ready` gate with a PR.' This is now false for both triage and reproduce, and AGENTS.md Process was corrected to say so.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Say 'Every delivery workflow (quick, story, release)'.
